mechanism_narrative: Elevated federal funds rates increase the cost of capital for corporations, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI index above 330 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 330 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rates and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 330) indicate a restrictive monetary policy environment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: dual pressure regime (high rates and high inflation)
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) does not yield a negative Rank IC below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates signal economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings prospects and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 4.5% indicate a deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1500 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent drop in industrial production and employment growth indicates a supply-side shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO and PAYEMS (as a product term) does not produce a negative Rank IC below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320), further inflationary pressures lead to negative S&P 500 returns due to central bank hawkishness over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 320 over a 3-year rolling window.
